/* outer /* nested */ still a comment */
@main def hello(args: String*): Unit =
  val name: Option[String] = args.headOption
  val count = 0xFF + 1_000L
  val pi = 3.14d
  val text = s"Hello, ${name.getOrElse("world")}! Count: $count\n"
  val formatted = f"$pi%.2f"
  val raw = raw"C:\temp\$count"
  val multi = """Multi "quoted"
    line \n stays"""
  val c = 'x'
  val esc = '\n'
  val sym = 'mySymbol
  println(text + formatted + raw + multi + c + esc + sym)

enum Color:
  case Red, Green

trait Shape:
  def area: Double

case class Circle(r: Double) extends Shape:
  def area: Double = math.Pi * r * r

given Ordering[Int] = Ordering.Int
val xs = List(1, 2, 3).map(_ * 2)
val ok = true && !false || null == None
